items: Asia's AI growth runs on two engines at once: top-down government programs, as in China, and grassroots startups solving local problems, as in India and Southeast Asia.
Singapore sits between the two, pairing clear AI governance with startup accelerators and enterprise adoption programs.
There is no single AI capital in Asia, so expect a network of centers, each with its own strengths.
If you expand into Asian markets, localize your AI products for each country and treat governments as potential partners as well as regulators.
